schedule.title: Arrival at the villa
schedule.text: The groom and Akamaru will welcome you to Villa Valentina, ready to begin this special day together.

schedule.title: The ceremony
schedule.text: The moment we make our love official, surrounded by the most important people in our lives.

schedule.title: Aperitivo
schedule.text: The ceremony is over: time to relax! Join us for drinks, bites to eat and time together.

schedule.title: Dinner
schedule.text: Time to take your seats! Enjoy dinner: the evening is still young.

schedule.title: Cutting the cake
schedule.text: Wedding cake, a few photographs and something sweet before returning to the celebrations.

schedule.title: One last toast and goodbyes
schedule.text: Liqueurs, chocolate and a few last conversations to end the evening and say goodbye.
